abstract: OBJECTIVE: To study the potential molecular mechanism of chemosensitive difference between human malignant epithelial and germ cell tumor of the ovary by testing the expression of p53 (mutation), Bcl-2, topoisomerase II alpha (Topo II alpha). METHODS: Immunohistochemical analysis was performed on paraffin embedded tumor tissue microarray from malignant epithelial (n=53) and germ cell tumor of the ovary (n=25) in the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics, Second West China Hospital of Sichuan University, China from the year 2000 to 2004. The expression of p53, Bcl-2 and Topo II alpha in the 2 types of ovarian cancer was compared and data were analyzed by student t test, Wilcoxon rank sum test and Spearman rank correlation test. RESULTS: The expression of p53 (mutation) in ovarian epithelial cancers (56.6%) was significantly higher than that in the malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary (28%), whereas the expression of Bcl-2 and Topo II alpha had no significant difference between the 2 groups. The expression of p53, Bcl-2 and Topo II alpha had no relationship with the Federation Internationale de Gynecologie Obstetrique (FIGO) stage. The age, FIGO stage and the chemotherapy response were significantly different between the 2 groups. CONCLUSION: The expression of p53 in ovarian cancer was related to chemosensitivity. Our results suggest that p53 may have a role on the difference of chemosensitivity between human malignant epithelial and germ cell tumor of the ovary.
abstract_ja: 目的：ヒト悪性上皮性卵巣腫瘍と卵巣胚細胞腫瘍との化学感受性の差の潜在的な分子機序を、p53（変異）、Bcl-2、トポイソメラーゼIIα（Topo II α）の発現を検査して調べること。方法：2000年から2004年にかけて、中国四川大学第二西中国病院婦人科において、悪性上皮性（n=53）および卵巣胚細胞腫瘍（n=25）のパラフィン包埋腫瘍組織マイクロアレイを用いて免疫組織化学的解析を行った。2群間のp53、Bcl-2、Topo II αの発現を比較し、データはスチューデントのt検定、ウィルコクソン順位和検定、スピアマン順位相関検定で解析した。結果：卵巣上皮性癌におけるp53（変異）の発現（56.6%）は、卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍（28%）より有意に高かった。一方、Bcl-2およびTopo II αの発現には2群間で有意差はなかった。p53、Bcl-2、Topo II αの発現はFIGO病期との関連を認めなかった。年齢、FIGO病期、化学療法への反応は2群間で有意に異なっていた。結論：卵巣癌におけるp53の発現は化学感受性と関連していた。本結果は、ヒト悪性上皮性卵巣腫瘍と卵巣胚細胞腫瘍との化学感受性の差にp53が関与している可能性を示唆する。
